findings.message: Path Traversal via faulty LLM-supplied CLI arguments in patched_event_validation.load_events()
findings.review_basis: Explicit operator-selected event input; the host caller supplies its private fixed event file. Only bounded validated numeric metadata reaches output; no lower-trust attacker path was established.
findings.additional_contract_evidence: connectors/lighttpd/tests/test_patched_event_validation.py::test_first_byte_writer_accepts_phase_aliases_and_preserves_schema explicitly succeeds with event input outside --runtime-output-root. Restricting inputs to the output root would change supported CLI behavior. The actual hosted caller passes a fixed private event snapshot.
findings.source_description_correction: The analyzer describes argparse.parse_args() in the local CLI as an HTTP request source; this entry point is a local operator tool, not an HTTP request handler.
